zh.title: AI 说“人已经批准了”，它就能替人执行吗？
zh.summary: Orca 的一次真实运行把 Agent 消息错当成人的许可。我们在 CodeFlowMu 的受控审批入口做六种对照，检查消息来源、确认凭据与实际操作能否被分清。

en.title: The AI says the human approved it. Can it act for them?
en.summary: An Orca run treated an Agent message as human permission. We tested six authorization-source and request-binding controls at CodeFlowMu
